extracted.stage: Estate administration, property awaiting sale, IHT due
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a c.£405,500 Reading estate (mainly the deceased's home, little cash) asks about borrowing £85,000 for tax and professional fees ahead of a 27 September tax deadline.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the Reading estate; we have logged the details you provided. To progress a review we would need confirmation of the grant of probate position, a breakdown of the estate assets and liabilities, evidence of the property value and any existing charges, the IHT figure and HMRC reference, and confirmation of all executors and their identification details. Please also confirm the marketing or sale status of the property. We cannot comment on terms, rates or availability at this stage, and nothing here should be taken as an offer of finance. A member of the team will be in touch once the information has been reviewed.
